long_description:
✨ Rooted in Wellness Series ✨

I’m excited to introduce a new monthly class series at Rooted Wellness & Spa designed to make healthy living simple, practical, and sustainable.

Each month, we’ll explore a new wellness topic — from detox and immune support to stress, sleep, and clean living — all through the lens of natural, plant-based solutions and foundational habits that support your everyday life.

Join us the last Thursday of each month at 6pm and bring a friend or 2 or 3 and you'll both receive a gift. I can’t wait 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Pleasanton, Workshops in Pleasanton.
